cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Test the Story First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to repeat the explanation, ask the dangerous question, or test the risky step before you commit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Try this banking-delay explanation for the raffle money on the committee chair before I sign. You've practised presenting with me; do the opening yourself.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not defending your accounts again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just the opening. You used to answer questions nobody asked. See whether she accepts a delay; then I'll take over.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll recognise your handwriting before I speak.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good spot. Leave the paper. Ask it as a general question, and don't improvise if she asks whose money. Come back to me first.
